$comment: Shared, checked-in Claude Code settings for Ridgeline. Local-only overrides
belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which is not committed.
The allow-list below covers read-only inspection and the project's own
verified gates, so agents stop stalling on routine commands mid-task. It is
deliberately conservative about anything that MUTATES state a person cares
- `git push`, `git commit`, `git merge`, `git reset` and `git checkout`
are NOT pre-approved. This repo has already lost work twice to a commit
that swept up another agent's in-flight file (reverted in f125ff0), and
the orchestrator is supposed to stage its own hunks deliberately.
- No `docker compose up/down`, no `helm upgrade`, no `kubectl apply`.
Those touch a running deployment; a person decides when that happens.
- `rm` is absent on purpose. A `prettier --write` over the wrong directory
once reformatted 93 files, and an over-broad `rm` once deleted the
screenshot set. Both were caught by hand, not by a rule.
Read commands (`kubectl get`, `helm list`, `docker ps`) are allowed because
answering "what is actually running?" with a fact instead of an opinion is
